simple.meaning: יֹשֶׁר (yôsher) is a Hebrew word meaning “the right.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יֹשֶׁר (H3476) appears 14 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 9:5, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, Job, Psalms, and 2 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יֹשֶׁר (H3476) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יֹשֶׁר (H3476) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יֹשֶׁר (yôsher) / H3476 is traced through Deuteronomy 9:5, 1 Kings 9:4, 1 Chronicles 29:17, Job 6:25 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

majorEvents.evidenceText: I know also, my God, that you try the heart, and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

timeline.evidenceText: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

As for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances;

I know also, my God, that you try the heart, and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.
How forcible are words of uprightness!
My words will utter the uprightness of my heart.
“If there is beside him an angel,
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me,
I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart,
who forsake the paths of uprightness,
I have taught you in the way of wisdom.
There is one who scatters, and increases yet more.
He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh,
Also to punish the righteous is not good,
The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

definitions.full: H3476. yosher י֫שֶׁר noun masculine Psa 25:21 straightness, uprightness ; — ישֶׁר Prov 2:13 11 t.; suffix יָשְׁרוֺ Job 33:23 ; Prov 14:2 ; — 1 straightness, evenness , of paths (with moral implication) Prov 2:13 ; 4:11 . 2 rightness, uprightness Prov 17:26 ; וָישֶׁר תֹּם Psa 25:21 ; of words, spoken Job 6:25 , written Eccl 12:10 ; of the moral walk בישׁר(וׅ 1Kin 9:4 ; Prov 14:2 ; ישֶׁרלִֿבִּי Job 33:3 ; לבב ישׁר Deut 9:5 ; Psa 119:7 ; 1Chr 29:17 : — on Psa 111:8 see יָשָׁר 4. 3. what is due, right Job 33:23 ; Prov 11:24 .
